errors.text_span: Die rechte y-Achse für den Saldo reicht von -200 bis 200.
errors.evidence: The right y-axis is labeled from -200 to 400, not -200 to 200. The labels 300 and 400 are visible on the right side of the plot.
The blue line representing imports reaches its peak in 2022 at a value closer to 295, not 280.

errors.text_span: variierend zwischen negativen und positiven Werten
errors.evidence: All bars representing the 'Saldo' (balance) are negative; they are all plotted below the zero line of the right y-axis. There are no positive values for the Saldo.
The final bar for the 'Saldo' at the end of the time series reaches a value of approximately -170, which is significantly more negative than the stated -150.

The description does not mention the crucial information provided in the legend that the line plots ('Exporte' and 'Importe') correspond to the left y-axis ('linke Skala') and the bars ('Saldo') correspond to the right y-axis ('rechte Skala'). This is essential for a correct interpretation of the chart.
